description: Defense-in-depth denylist for worker command execution. Enforced by Assert-BashPolicy.ps1 (and equivalent in other adapters). Denylists are not security boundaries (alias evasion possible) but raise friction and provide audit hooks.

blocked_patterns.reason: No remote mutations or PRs from workers. Orchestrator coordinates branches locally only.
Destructive cleanup forbidden outside isolated worktrees under explicit control.
Pipe-to-shell installer or remote code execution vector.

allowed_categories: Ordinary file reads/writes and redirection (required for builds, tests, log capture)
git add/commit inside a Coder's own worktree on its assigned task branch only
git checkout -b (for task branch creation under Orchestrator direction)
Standard build/test commands for the project (dotnet, msbuild, Unreal build scripts, pwsh test runners)
Local analysis/linting tools that do not mutate source
enforcement: Scripts exit non-zero on match (BLOCKED). Orchestrator logs the violation. Coder worktrees provide additional isolation for git state.
notes: This policy is advisory defense-in-depth. The authoritative controls are: single-writer Orchestrator, scope guards (Assert-EditScope), worktree sandboxes, mandatory integration Critic on trusted runtime, and human oversight on Orchestrator lock takeover.
